note: Proposed. On 2026-11-04 the Hugging Face API listed no dataset for the AlphaAvatar organization and answered 401 for this repo without a token: not published, or not public. Publishing fills revision (the 40-hex commit), license and each sample's sha256 and bytes.

long_session.use: 30 minutes of speech and pauses, 16 kHz mono PCM16: long-run VAD, STT and turn-taking stability

multi_speaker.use: two speakers taking turns and overlapping: turn-taking and speaker attribution

noisy_room.use: speech over room and street noise: VAD and STT robustness

barge_in.use: a user speaking over the answer: barge-in and output interruption

face_toward_away.use: a face turning toward and away from the camera: visual addressing and face analysis
